$comment: Hand-written at adoption on 2026-11-10 because `nen shu detect` answered `no lane detected`; re-declared on 2026-11-11 when issue #1 moved the site from a Python generator to Gatsby + TypeScript + Chakra UI (zheref/swift-cheatsheets#1). The `dependency` block is copied from Hatsu's own contract at its pinned build and moves only at a repin. The `project` block declares exactly what package.json runs; every verb the repository does not have is an explicit seat with its reason, never an omission.

build.$comment: Gatsby production build into public/, then the offline single-file export written to the committed index.html.

lint.$comment: tsc --noEmit, then scripts/verify.mts's structural checks on both built pages; runs after `build` in iteration.checks.

test.$comment: The whole suite (a few seconds): content and anchor parity with the pre-migration page, highlighter and search parity, loader refusals, static render + hydration, both adapters, the offline file from disk. Writes the lcov capture the coverage row reads.

coverage.$comment: Extraction only: the test row wrote coverage/lcov.info (v8 provider, src/** and gatsby-*.ts[x]); this row runs nothing (byakugan section 3).

ui-test.unsupported: No browser end-to-end suite; rendering, hydration and interaction are exercised in jsdom by the test row, and the built pages by `lint`.

archive.unsupported: The distributable is the committed offline index.html that `build` regenerates; no separate archive step exists.

run.unsupported: There is no production start: the site is served from public/ by `dev`, or the offline file is opened directly.

deploy.unsupported: No deploy destination has been chosen; the site is served locally over the LAN.

release.unsupported: No publication destination has been chosen; nothing here publishes a release.

node.why: Gatsby 5.16 supports Node 18-25 (package.json engines caps it below 26); jsdom 31 and vitest 5 need 22.22+ on the 22 line or 24.15+ on the 24 line (package.json engines: ^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0; nen reads a floor only). .nvmrc pins 24. nen never installs a host toolchain.
